submit_report.name: submit_report
submit_report.description: Save a hazard or welfare report. Returns report_id, severity and cluster_match.

hazard.description: What is happening, a few words.

location_text.description: Confirmed address, cross streets or landmark.

people_at_risk.description: Number of people at risk, 0 if unknown.

vulnerability.description: e.g. wheelchair, oxygen, elderly_alone, baby, no_car, pets.

submit_report.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "Okay, I'm logging that now."

flag_urgent.name: flag_urgent
flag_urgent.description: Mark this call life-safety urgent (P0) or self-harm so a supervisor sees it now.

reason.description: e.g. trapped, not_breathing, chest_pain, self_harm, keypad_hurt.

route_to_human.name: route_to_human
route_to_human.description: Find an available person on our team. Returns oncall_number (empty if nobody), responder_name, brief, match_reason.

needs.description: Skills, e.g. medical, mental_health, evac_logistics, listener, security (break-ins, threats, suspicious person), lang:ko.

severity.description: Severity: P0 life in danger now, P1 active hazard, P2 needs a person soon, P3 routine.

summary.description: One sentence for the person taking over.

transfer_failed.description: true only if transfer_to_human just failed to connect; returns their backup.

location_text.description: Where the caller is, if no report was filed (picks someone who covers that area).

route_to_human.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "Let me find someone for you."

schedule_callback.name: schedule_callback
schedule_callback.description: Queue a callback from a person. Returns a code and ETA.

lookup_info.name: lookup_info
lookup_info.description: Approved current info: programs and hotlines, or the nearest suitable place (shelter, cooling or charging, food, health, pets). Returns answer, resource_name, transfer_number.

location_text.description: Only for a nearby place: cross streets, landmark or neighborhood. Otherwise empty.

needs.description: Only needs the caller mentioned: wheelchair, pets, oxygen_power, no_car, tonight. Otherwise empty.

lookup_info.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "Let me check that."

create_request.name: create_request
create_request.description: Create a help request (errand, ride, check on someone, supplies, other). Returns a code.

type.description: errand, ride, check_on_person, supplies or other.

set_reminder.name: set_reminder
set_reminder.description: Schedule a reminder call. Returns a code.

enroll_checkin.name: enroll_checkin
enroll_checkin.description: Enroll a person in check-in calls; pending until they agree. Returns a code.

enrolled_by.description: self, or caller name and relationship.

notify_contact.name: notify_contact
notify_contact.description: Queue a message to the caller's contact. Requires consent true.

check_status.name: check_status
check_status.description: Status of a request by code and the last 4 digits of the caller's phone.

opt_out.name: opt_out
opt_out.description: Stop calls, analytics, or both and delete data.

register_volunteer.name: register_volunteer
register_volunteer.description: Register a volunteer as pending verification. Returns a code.

transfer_to_human.name: transfer_to_human
transfer_to_human.description: Warm-transfer to the person route_to_human found.

private_handoff_option.prompt: Brief the responder in two short sentences: who is calling and in what language, where they are, what is happening and how urgent, and why this responder was chosen ({{match_reason}}). Then say you're connecting them.

public_handoff_option.message: I've connected you with {{responder_name}}, who can help from here.

transfer_to_human.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "Connecting you now. Please stay on the line."

transfer_to_crisis_line.name: transfer_to_crisis_line
transfer_to_crisis_line.description: Transfer to the suicide and crisis line.
transfer_to_crisis_line.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "I'm connecting you now. Please stay on the line."

swap_to_crisis.name: swap_to_crisis
swap_to_crisis.description: Hand the call to crisis intake.
swap_to_crisis.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "Okay, stay with me."

swap_to_inbound.name: swap_to_inbound
swap_to_inbound.description: Hand the call back to the everyday line.

start_form.name: start_form
start_form.description: Start an intake form with what the caller already said. Returns case_code and the fields still needed.

known_fields.description: Field name to answer for everything already said; {} if nothing.

fill_form.name: fill_form
fill_form.description: Save form answers. Returns missing, invalid, complete and readback.

submit_form.name: submit_form
submit_form.description: Submit a completed, confirmed form. Returns code and next_step_text.
submit_form.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "One moment."

request_escort.name: request_escort
request_escort.description: Request a safety escort (walk or ride). Returns a code.

book_appointment.name: book_appointment
book_appointment.description: Book time with a person who has a skill (listener, housing, academics). Returns a code and slot.

send_link.name: send_link
send_link.description: Text the caller a private status or photo-upload link for their code. Returns sent.

record_consent.name: record_consent
record_consent.description: Record clip consent (drill calls) and analytics consent.

analytics_consent.description: False if they opted out of statistics.

swap_to_korean.name: swap_to_korean
swap_to_korean.description: Hand the call to the Korean line.

swap_to_chinese.name: swap_to_chinese
swap_to_chinese.description: Hand the call to the Mandarin Chinese line.

swap_to_english_spanish.name: swap_to_english_spanish
swap_to_english_spanish.description: Hand the call to the English/Spanish line.

transfer_to_resource.name: transfer_to_resource
transfer_to_resource.description: Transfer to the place or hotline lookup_info returned.
transfer_to_resource.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "Connecting you to {{resource_name}} now."

swap_to_services.name: swap_to_services
swap_to_services.description: Hand the call to the help desk for requests, forms, escorts, appointments, reminders, sign-ups, status and volunteering.

text_caller.name: text_caller
text_caller.description: Text the caller (only after they said yes) the details you just gave: a place with address and directions link, a hotline number, or their case code.
text_caller.execution_message_description: Say briefly, in the caller's language, that you're texting it now.

sms_content.prompt: Write ONE text message under 320 characters, in the caller's language, with only what you just told or created for this caller. Start with 'DIZA Community Line:'. If you just created a location link with request_location, the message is only: 'DIZA Community Line: tap to share your exact location with our team: <the link>. Emergency: call 911.' For a place: name, street address, and a Google Maps directions link https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=<address URL-encoded with + for spaces>, plus 'Call 211 to confirm it is open' if you said it opens only when activated. For a hotline: name and number. For a request: their code and what happens next. Add 'Emergency: call 911.' Never include anyone else's information. End with 'Reply STOP to opt out.'

request_location.name: request_location
request_location.description: Create a one-time link the caller taps to share their exact GPS location with our team. Returns link; then send it with text_caller.

swap_to_armenian.name: swap_to_armenian
swap_to_armenian.description: Hand the call to the Armenian line.

swap_to_persian.name: swap_to_persian
swap_to_persian.description: Hand the call to the Persian (Farsi) line.

swap_to_tagalog.name: swap_to_tagalog
swap_to_tagalog.description: Hand the call to the Filipino (Tagalog) line.

brief_security.name: brief_security
brief_security.description: DIZA phones the on-duty security person with a short spoken briefing about a break-in, theft, vandalism, threat or suspicious person. Returns status (calling, no_security_on_duty, failed) and security_name. Never replaces 911.

incident.description: One sentence: what happened, e.g. 'Apartment door forced open, laptop missing'.

location_text.description: Where, as the caller confirmed it (address, unit, cross streets or landmark).

caller_quote.description: The caller's own words about it.

in_progress.description: True if it is happening now or the person may still be there.

brief_security.execution_message_description: In the caller's language, say a very short line like: "One moment, I'm letting security know."
